description: Write a method with an if-block local, a loop index, and a parameter. Deliberately try to print the if-local after the block; paste the compiler error into a comment. Then write a correct version that returns all needed values. Explain in three sentences where each variable lives.
practice_instructions: Write 2 short Java programs that practice: Scope. EXPECTED: compile and run cleanly with clear output.
title: Scope hunt

description: Implement methods on int[]: min, max, reverse in place, rotate right by k (k may exceed n), frequency of a target, prefixSum returning a new array, and print a 3×3 matrix in row-major order. description: Read a line (or hardcode a paragraph). Implement: isPalindrome (ignore case), char frequency map as a printed table, word count via split, and a transform that strips punctuation. description: Implement Book (title, author, pages) and Student (id, name) with methods that print a one-line summary. Construct at least two of each in main. Do not build a database or REST API. description: Create a tiny Box { int x; } or use a one-field class. 1) a = new; b = a; mutate via b; print a. 2) method mutate(Box b) { b.x++; } 3) method rebind(Box b) { b = new Box(); b.x = 99; } show the caller is unchanged. 4) Draw (comments/ASCII) a two-node linked list and set node.next. description: Track two ML runs with MLflow
practice_instructions: Use MLflow Tracking (or any tracker) to log parameters and metrics for two training runs with different hyperparameters. Then compare the two runs side by side. Completion criteria: both runs visible in the tracking UI with params+metrics, and you can state which run won and why.
title: Track two ML runs with MLflow

description: Detect drift in a data slice
practice_instructions: Take a small dataset and simulate drift by shifting one feature distribution (e.g., add noise or scale a column). Write down 3 signals that would indicate drift in production, then verify each against your shifted data. Completion criteria: at least one signal fires and you can explain what changed.
title: Detect drift in a data slice
